name: proposals-github
title: Self-improvement on GitHub: the agent's changes as pull requests
description: proposals as GitHub pull requests from pikit/self/* (Cloudflare): read with the agent's token, merged or closed with a token the agent never holds when an operator approves or rejects them in the dashboard; and the project's CI workflow. Dormant until connected, after deploying: the repository from the dashboard's Settings, the two tokens as secrets.

environment.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environment.description: Connects self-improvement (optional: set it after deploying). A fine-grained GitHub token for the project's repository only, the agent's: Contents and Pull requests read and write (it pushes pikit/self/* branches and opens pull requests), Checks and Commit statuses read. proposals-github reads proposals with it; it never merges.

environment.name: PIKIT_MERGE_TOKEN
environment.description: Connects self-improvement (optional: set it after deploying). Another fine-grained GitHub token for the same repository only, never the agent's: Contents and Pull requests read and write. It merges and closes the agent's pull requests when you approve or reject them in the dashboard.
